entities.name: George Thomson, Baron Thomson of Monifieth

entities.summary: George Morgan Thomson, Baron Thomson of Monifieth, was a British politician and journalist who served as a Labour MP. He was a member of Harold Wilson's cabinet, and later became a European Commissioner.
